citation_and_instruction_findings: Running header 'יוצר ליום ראשון של ראש השנה' and page number 36 (both sides) are present in print. They are not body text and are correctly handled by printed_page '36'.
No commentary note, rubric, speaker siglum or instruction is printed on s100 apart from the unexplained marginal siglum at stanza 24 (see unresolved).
Human decision #2 (תִחֵת … תָּר) matches the current text. The first glyph of תִחֵת is visibly damaged in print, which is consistent with it needing human adjudication. I did not reopen it.

All other words and stanza order (14 continuation through 26, ending 'קָדוֹשׁ:') match the image at this resolution. That includes punctuation (periods inside stanzas, sof-pasuq colons at stanza ends) and the maqafs in יַעֲצָר־כֹּחַ, מִכָּל־רוּחַ and בְּכָל־פֹּעַל. Stanza 26 is printed centred/indented as a separate closing block, consistent with paragraph 4.

source_findings.reason: The print reads 'prophesy' (the verb) where the noun 'prophecy' is meant. The current text keeps the printed form, which is correct, but it isn't marked. Under the preserve-typo-with-sic/corr policy, it should get sic/corr markup. Low-severity editorial markup; the source wording itself is unchanged.

Lowercase 'he' in 'all that he may do' (stanza 25) matches the print exactly and is kept correctly. It is not a typo needing sic.
'fulfils' is a British spelling and is correct as printed.
Header 'Morning Prayer for the New Year' and page number 36 are not body text and are handled by printed_page '36'.

Stanza 26 English is printed as a separate indented block, matching paragraph 4. Line order and punctuation of stanzas 14 to 26 match the image, including the question mark after 'bear Him?' and the em-dash-free wording on this page.
